cmd:
cd /app && grep -c $'\0' data.txt; tail -c 50 data.txt | xxd | tail -3; python3 -c "
d=open('data.txt','rb').read()
print('len',len(d),'nul',d.count(0),'maxbyte',max(d))
print('repetitions sample:', d.count(b'compression'), d.count(b' data'), d.count(b' the'))"
which python python2 gcc cc g++ perl awk busybox 2>&1; od -c data.txt | grep -m2 '\\0'; tail -c 60 data.txt | od -c | tail -4
tr -cd '\0' < data.txt | wc -c; grep -o 'compression' data.txt | wc -l; grep -o 'data' data.txt | wc -l
cd /app && sed -i 's/int CB\[64\], CCtx\[64\];/int CCtx[64]; unsigned char CB[64];/' enc.c && gcc -O2 -o enc enc.c -Wall 2>&1 | head -5; time ./enc
cd /app && cat data.comp | ./decomp > out.txt; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c out.txt data.txt; cmp out.txt data.txt && echo ROUNDTRIP_OK
cd /app && time ./enc && cat data.comp | ./decomp > out.txt && cmp out.txt data.txt && echo ROUNDTRIP_OK

cd /app && sed -i 's/            long total;/            long total; long cover = 0;/' enc.c && sed -i 's/^                total = c1;$/                total = c1; cover = o1[i].len;/' enc.c && sed -i 's/^                total = -1;$/                total = -1; cover = 0;/' enc.c && sed -i 's/^                    long t = c1 + c2;$/                    long t = c1 + c2; long cv = o1[i].len + o2[j].len;/' enc.c && sed -i 's/if (total < 0 || t < total) { total = t; bi2 = j; }/if (total < 0 || t < total || (t == total \&\& cv > cover)) { total = t; cover = cv; bi2 = j; }/' enc.c && sed -i 's/^        long best_total = -1;$/        long best_total = -1; long best_cover = 0;/' enc.c && sed -i 's/if (best_total < 0 || total < best_total) {/if (best_total < 0 || total < best_total || (total == best_total \&\& cover > best_cover)) {/' enc.c && sed -i 's/                best_total = total; bi1 = i;/                best_total = total; best_cover = cover; bi1 = i;/' enc.c && grep -n "best_cover\|long cover\|long cv" enc.c
cd /app && gcc -O2 -o enc enc.c -Wall 2>&1 | grep -c warning; time ./enc && cat data.comp | ./decomp > out.txt && cmp out.txt data.txt && echo ROUNDTRIP_OK
